content: Implement ArxivSource in alcanzai_ingestion/arxiv_source.py. Deps: add httpx to alcanzai-ingestion/pyproject.toml (no lxml, use stdlib xml.etree.ElementTree; no OTel). normalize() generates job_id UUID; CLI (#30) injects artifact_path via FetchResult.source_metadata. Unit tests mock HTTP with httpx. Reference: prototype/paper_library/arxiv_fetcher.py (read only).
